•	First, for the MCI data, the cause_of_death has a key and several columns that need to be decoded using the codebook here
o	Original source found here (the “BJS Mortality in Correctional Institutions State Prison Data” codebook)
•	Then, combine the mci and state_docs (“docs” is dept of corrections) csvs into one


```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
```


```{r data}
mci<-read.csv("mci_2016_2019_04062026.csv")
doc<-read.csv("state_docs_excl_2016_to_2019_04082026.csv")
```

exploring missingness in each dataset
```{r missingness}
#mci
causespec<-c("illspec",
      "drugspec",
      "homispec",
      "suicspec",
      "selfspec",
      "accspec",
      "otherspec")

mci %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(causespec), ~ is.na(.) | . == "" | . == "Undetermined")) %>%
  count()
#293

commoncausespec<-mci %>% count(across(all_of(causespec)))%>%arrange(desc(n))

mci %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(causespec), ~ is.na(.) | . == "" | . == "Undetermined")) %>%
  count(state_abbrev, sort = TRUE)

#AL has the most missingness (86), followed by FL (42) then OR (23)

mci%>%count(state_abbrev, sort = TRUE)
#and the missingness patterns are not the same/proportional to the # of vals from each state

#doc 


```

exploring and cleaning mci
```{r mci}
#codebook vals
#lname (dont have)
#fname (dont have)
#mname (dont have)

#dobmon (have), dobday (have), dobyear (have)
str(mci$date_of_birth)
#need to mutate to have day, m, year, in different locations 
mci$date_of_birth<-as.Date(mci$date_of_birth)
str(mci$date_of_birth)
mci <- mci %>%
  mutate(
    Dobmon = month(date_of_birth),
    Dobday = day(date_of_birth),
    Dobyear = year(date_of_birth)
  )


#state (have as state_abbrev)

state_lookup <- c(
  AL = 1, AK = 2, AZ = 3, AR = 4, CA = 5, CO = 6, CT = 7, DE = 8,
  FL = 10, GA = 11, HI = 12, ID = 13, IL = 14, IN = 15, IA = 16,
  KS = 17, KY = 18, LA = 19, ME = 20, MD = 21, MA = 22, MI = 23,
  MN = 24, MS = 25, MO = 26, MT = 27, NE = 28, NV = 29, NH = 30,
  NJ = 31, NM = 32, NY = 33, NC = 34, ND = 35, OH = 36, OK = 37,
  OR = 38, PA = 39, RI = 40, SC = 41, SD = 42, TN = 43, TX = 44,
  UT = 45, VT = 46, VA = 47, WA = 48, WV = 49, WI = 50, WY = 51
)

mci <- mci %>%
  mutate(State = state_lookup[state_abbrev])

#year (reporting year, ASSUMING this is death year), deathmon (have), deathday (have)
str(mci$death_date_dt)
#need to mutate to have day, m, year, in different locations 
mci$death_date_dt<-as.Date(mci$death_date_dt)
str(mci$death_date_dt)
mci <- mci %>%
  mutate(
    Deathmon = month(death_date_dt),
    Deathday = day(death_date_dt),
    Year = year(death_date_dt)
  )

#facname (have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Facname=facility_name)

#facloc (have)
#does this include address? 

#gender (have)
str(mci$sex)
mci%>%group_by(sex)%>%count()
#have 3 -1 vals, in this dataset they call it sex, in the codebook they call it gender? 
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Gender=sex)

#race (have)
mci%>%group_by(race)%>%count()

mci <- mci %>%
  mutate(
    Race = case_when(
      race == "White, non-Hispanic" ~ 1,
      race == "Black, non-Hispanic" ~ 2,
      race == "Hispanic or Latino" ~ 3,
      race == "Native American" ~ 4,
      race == "Asian, non-Hispanic" ~ 5,
      race == "Pacific Islander" ~ 6,
      race == "Other" ~ 8,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

#hispanic (have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Hispanic=(if_else(Race==3, 1, 0)))

#races 1-6 (have)
#but does this refer to being of mixed race? or is this just a binary place to hold racE? I think just a binary place to hold race 

mci<-mci%>%mutate(Race1=(if_else(race=="White, non-Hispanic", 1, 0)))
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Race2=(if_else(race=="Black, non-Hispanic", 1, 0)))
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Race3=(if_else(race=="Native American", 1, 0)))
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Race4=(if_else(race=="Asian, non-Hispanic", 1, 0)))
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Race5=(if_else(race=="Pacific Islander", 1, 0)))
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Race6=(if_else(race== "Other", 1, 0)))

#oth race (dont have)
#admitmon (don't have)
#admitday (dont have)
#admityr(dont have)
#curroff 1-5 (dont have)
#mental stay (dont have)
#death loc (dont have)
#othloc (don't have)

#evaluate (have)
mci%>%group_by(cause_of_death)%>%count()
mci <- mci %>%
  mutate(evaluate = if_else(!is.na(cause_of_death) & cause_of_death != "", 1, NA_real_))
mci%>%group_by(evaluate)%>%count()

#cause (have)
mci%>%group_by(cause_of_death)%>%count()
cod_lookup <- c(
  "Illness (exclude AIDS-related deaths), specify illness"                                    = 1,
  "Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS-related)"                                        = 2,
  "Accidental Alcohol/drug intoxication (specify type)"                                       = 3,
  "Accidental injury to self, describe events"                                                = 4,
  "Accidental injury by other (e.g. vehicular accident during transport) – describe events"   = 5,
  "Suicide (e.g. hanging, knife/cutting instrument, intentional drug overdose) – describe events" = 6,
  "Homicide (all years except 2011 and 2012)"                                                 = 7,
  "Other causes, specify causes"                                                              = 8
)

mci <- mci %>%
  mutate(cause = cod_lookup[cause_of_death])
mci%>%group_by(cause)%>%count() #same 

#illspec (have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Illspec=illspec)

#drugspec (have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Drugspec=drugspec)

#selfspec(have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Selfspec=selfspec)

#accspec(have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Accspec=accspec)

#suispec (have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Suicspec=suicspec)

#homispec (have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Homispec=homispec)

#otherspec (have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Otherspec=otherspec)

#medcond, medtrt 1-9 (dont have)
#time (dont have)
#place (have)
mci<-mci%>%mutate(Place=place)

#place_select (dont have)
#insplace (dont have)
#othplace (dont have)
#forespec (dont have)
#notes (dont have)

mci<-mci%>%mutate(is_mci=1)

mciaccident<-mci%>%filter(Cause== 3|Cause==4|Cause==5)
```

exploring and cleaning doc 
```{r doc}
#actually has quite different COD names, this is why we would need the algorithm, I get it 

doc$death_date_dt<-as.Date(doc$death_date_dt)
doc$date_of_birth<-as.Date(doc$date_of_birth)
doc<-doc%>%mutate(is_doc=1)

docillness<-doc%>%filter()
```

combining DOC and MCI
```{r mcidocjoin}

combined <- bind_rows(mci, doc)
class(combined)


combined$location <- paste(combined$incident_location, combined$location, sep = ", ")


combined<-combined%>%select(-Dobmon, -Dobday, -Dobyear, -Deathmon, -Deathday, -Year, -Place, -State, -Facname, -Gender, - Race, -Hispanic, -Race1, -Race2, -Race3, -Race4, -Race5, -Race6, -Illspec, -Drugspec, -Selfspec, -Accspec, -Suicspec, -Homispec, -Otherspec, -incident_location)
write.csv(combined, "mci_doc_combined.csv")
```

exploring the combined category
```{r combined}
combined%>%group_by(cause_of_death)%>%count()

#there are a lot
```
